cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: The code constructs a shell command string using util.format() with unescaped hostname interpolation, but CWE-116 specifically addresses improper encoding/escaping when preparing structured messages for communication between components, not necessarily shell command construction

connection.evidence: External hostname input flows directly from function parameter to shell.exec() via util.format() interpolation without escaping

diff_causality.evidence: The added validation check does not materially change the encoding/escaping mechanism - the command construction remains vulnerable regardless of validation outcome

security_control.required_control: Proper output encoding/escaping when constructing shell commands
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-116 requires proper encoding when preparing structured messages for communication; shell commands require proper escaping of user input
existing_controls_checked: isValidHostName() regex validation that filters some characters but doesn't escape shell metacharacters
security_control.deficiency_evidence: The validation acts as input filtering but doesn't provide proper output encoding for shell command context; util.format() doesn't escape shell metacharacters

concrete_impact.evidence: Command injection could lead to arbitrary command execution if validation is bypassed, but validation limits character set significantly

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, the validation check would be removed, but the underlying encoding deficiency in command construction would remain unchanged.
supporting_evidence: hostname parameter flows directly to shell.exec() via util.format() interpolation
util.format() does not perform shell metacharacter escaping
Command construction: util.format('"%s" "%s" %s', nodeBinary, scriptPath, hostname)
contradicting_evidence: CWE-116 focuses on structured message communication between components, while this is shell command construction which is better covered by CWE-78
The validation regex significantly restricts allowed characters (alphanumeric, hyphen, dot only)
unresolved_facts: Whether shell.exec() has any built-in escaping or sandboxing
Whether the DNS lookup script itself performs additional validation
review_comment: The hostname parameter is interpolated into a shell command without proper escaping, though the regex validation restricts allowed characters. Use shell parameterization or proper escaping functions like child_process.spawn() with separate arguments instead of string interpolation to prevent command injection.
